properties.label: Workflow evaluation does not execute recovery
properties.description: Recovery planning returns intent and plan while Operation invocation remains external.
properties.forbidden_inference: A named callable at composition does not imply it was invoked.

properties.label: Recovery Intent identity is complete and unique
properties.description: One immutable failure occurrence maps to at most one intent containing every D37 identity field.
properties.forbidden_inference: Workflow execution ID and failed step ID alone are not the complete D37 identity.

properties.label: Plan identity is immutable
properties.description: Plan digest, occurrence order, and exact bindings cannot change after dispatch creation.
properties.forbidden_inference: Readonly process memory is not durable immutability evidence.

properties.label: Each plan occurrence has stable identity
properties.description: The same Operation may appear at distinct plan occurrences, each with a distinct stable occurrence identity.
properties.forbidden_inference: Operation ID alone cannot identify an occurrence.

properties.label: Binding preflight completes before invocation
properties.description: Every plan occurrence resolves to one exact Operation binding before the first Operation invocation.
properties.forbidden_inference: Resolving bindings lazily after mutation violates the property.

properties.label: Dispatch transitions use version compare-and-set
properties.description: Every advancement compares the expected dispatch version and increments one committed version.
properties.forbidden_inference: A process mutex is not durable compare-and-set evidence.

properties.label: Dispatch transition and outbox are atomic
properties.description: A dispatch transition and its dispatch outbox record become visible together or neither does.
properties.forbidden_inference: Publishing an Event after a commit without an outbox does not satisfy atomicity.

properties.label: Durable progress is monotonic
properties.description: A completed plan occurrence cannot disappear or become incomplete on retry, takeover, or restart.
properties.forbidden_inference: A worker-local completed list is not durable progress.

properties.label: At most one current Claim exists
properties.description: One dispatch has no more than one current Claim at a committed version.
properties.forbidden_inference: One observed worker does not prove exclusive Claim state.

properties.label: Fencing tokens are strictly monotonic
properties.description: Every takeover receives a token greater than every previously committed token for the dispatch.
properties.forbidden_inference: Wall-clock order cannot substitute for committed fencing order.

properties.label: Advancement requires current Claim and active Lease
properties.description: Every state-changing dispatch commit proves both current fenced Claim and latest active Lease.
properties.forbidden_inference: Possessing a Claim ID alone is insufficient.

properties.label: Lease generations are monotonic
properties.description: Renewal preserves Claim and fence while creating a greater committed Lease generation.
properties.forbidden_inference: Extending an in-memory expiry timestamp does not prove committed renewal.

properties.label: Stale workers cannot commit
properties.description: Expired, released, or superseded authority is rejected at the durable commit boundary.
properties.forbidden_inference: A worker-side precheck cannot replace commit-time rejection.

properties.label: Attempt identity is unique per executor episode
properties.description: Each actual execution episode creates one new Attempt; Claim and Lease operations alone create none.
properties.forbidden_inference: Retry number or Claim ID alone is not an Attempt identity.

properties.label: Invocation Identity is stable across attempts
properties.description: All attempts for one plan occurrence use H(intent, plan, Operation, occurrence) and exclude execution metadata.
properties.forbidden_inference: A deterministic key missing canonical identity inputs is only partial evidence.

properties.label: Semantic application occurs at most once
properties.description: The Operation or its adapter durably returns the recorded result on replay without repeating the business effect.
properties.forbidden_inference: At-most-once semantic application is not exactly-once process execution.

properties.label: Authority loss during execution yields unknown
properties.description: If effective Lease validity is lost after invocation starts, the Attempt becomes unknown before replay.
properties.forbidden_inference: Process loss is not proof of Operation failure.

properties.label: Retry is persisted and bounded
properties.description: Explicit continuation, policy ref, remaining budget, and not-before are committed before re-eligibility.
properties.forbidden_inference: Claim acquisition, Lease renewal, or an in-memory loop is not Retry.

properties.label: Retry and restart do not replan or substitute
properties.description: All continuations preserve the frozen plan, occurrence, binding, and Invocation Identity.
properties.forbidden_inference: A behaviorally similar Operation is not the selected binding.

properties.label: Terminal disposition requires evidence and has no successor
properties.description: Completed, exhausted, or escalated is durable, evidence-bound, and cannot implicitly select more work.
properties.forbidden_inference: One failed Attempt cannot directly establish terminal recovery state.

properties.label: Operation effect authority is preserved
properties.description: The coordinator supplies Invocation Identity but the Operation retains guards, reads, writes, effects, Events, and its state-and-outbox boundary.
properties.forbidden_inference: Dispatch authority grants no undeclared business effect.

properties.label: Restart resumes at the first incomplete occurrence
properties.description: Reopening durable state preserves completed progress and selects only the first incomplete plan occurrence.
properties.forbidden_inference: Starting the whole plan again is not valid restart recovery.

properties.label: Missing evidence remains unsupported
properties.description: An absent or indeterminate architecture observation yields unsupported rather than PASS.
properties.forbidden_inference: Naming similarity or an unexecuted test cannot fill a property finding.

properties.label: Delivery claim is at-least-once invocation
properties.description: Invocation and publication may repeat; semantic application is protected separately by Invocation Identity.
properties.forbidden_inference: The architecture cannot claim universal exactly-once process execution.

properties.label: Semantic and operational state remain separate
properties.description: D37 required/satisfied/unresolved, D38 dispatch state, D39 attempt outcome, and D44 disposition remain distinct axes.
properties.forbidden_inference: Requested, running, failed, or worker state cannot replace the canonical axes.

properties.label: Dependency contracts remain concern-specific
properties.description: Every dependency seam is named for one responsibility and no universal code-level Port abstraction is required.
properties.forbidden_inference: A shared ontology element class cannot become a universal runtime interface or DI framework.

properties.label: Repository contract and Persistence Binding remain distinct
properties.description: The consumer-owned repository signature and the metadata mapping to an adapter, resource, profile, and evidence boundary are separate artifacts.
properties.forbidden_inference: A repository shape or DomainSpec Interface does not itself select or prove persistence.

properties.label: Unit of Work and Transaction Guarantee Binding remain distinct
properties.description: The local transaction code contract remains separate from the metadata declaration of participants, guarantees, provider profile, failure outcomes, and evidence.
properties.forbidden_inference: A Unit of Work name cannot prove atomicity or widen it across the Workflow.

properties.label: Failure classification does not select Retry
properties.description: Retryable, non-retryable, and unknown outcomes preserve raw evidence while D43 continuation remains separately selected and bounded.
properties.forbidden_inference: Classification cannot erase unknown state or grant retry authority.

properties.label: Durable runtime binding is complete
properties.description: A durable Workflow profile binds exact persistence, transaction, failure, scheduler, Clock, optional Wakeup, replay, version, and evidence surfaces.
properties.forbidden_inference: Synchronous Workflows do not inherit durable runtime obligations and one provider cannot define portable Workflow meaning.
